title: Implement DOMAIN_ACTIVATION and FE/BE parallel autonomy
objective: Make persisted actionable FE/BE work wake its exact owning domain automatically through level-triggered reconciliation, without a central next-role dispatcher or event/queue authority.
architectureDecisions: event/watch/poll/restart inputs are wake-up hints only; canonical state is re-read on every reconcile
Activation != Scheduling and does not rank multiple actionable work items
activation works on exact projectId/workId/owningDomain keys, never role/stage names
duplicate triggers converge through canonical lifecycle/claim fencing
missed triggers are recovered by domain-specific canonical scans; event queue/cache is disposable
no transactional outbox is required for correctness in D v1
activation never resolves ExecutionStrategy; BB-048 remains the HOW boundary
post-claim/post-release source-obligation currentness is revalidated before execution entry
FE and BE are independently activatable and may use different strategy kinds/versions

planningBaseline.note: planning only; activation after BB-049 must use then-current source head

requirements: canonical domain scan is mandatory recovery source
event/watch source is optional latency optimization
NOOP is normal when current state is not actionable
trusted domain principal binding is runtime configuration, not trigger payload
after claim/release, exact source obligation/currentness is revalidated before DomainExecutionController entry
stale race invalidates canonical organization claim and fences release
do not reuse createDurableBackendQaWorkflow as the strategy because it contains QA cross-domain control
Backend strategy terminates at Backend-owned output/evidence/publication

implementationSlices.output: first real Frontend domain + domain-local strategy using same organization/execution contracts
requirements: no shared conversation dependency with Backend
FE and BE can progress independently
one domain outage does not block unrelated domain work
remove manual next-role dispatcher from acceptance path
emit low-cost DomainActivationObservation telemetry without making telemetry authority

hardInvariants: one domain outage must not block unrelated domain work
queued stale hints cannot resurrect invalidated work
acceptanceCriteria: persisted actionable FE/BE work is eventually discovered after process restart even if original notification is lost
duplicate event + scan hints for same work converge to one current claim/execution
FE and BE execute independently under different domain-local strategy descriptors
old activation hint becomes NOOP after obligation/work invalidation
obligation supersession between activation pre-check and claim/release cannot enter execution after post-release recheck
one-domain-down fixture still allows independent domain progress
manual next-role dispatch can be removed without halting organization progress
mandatoryNegativeTests: activate BACKEND role/stage instead of exact work key
lost queue entry strands canonical actionable work
duplicate triggers create two current claims/attempts
FE waits for whole Backend stage absent an exact dependency
stale queued trigger executes after selective invalidation

activationRule.when: BB-049 is terminal accepted/DONE and cross-domain obligation/currentness/materialization semantics are current
activationRule.createContext: materialize new WORK_CONTEXT_SPEC from then-current head and pin this artifact + exact BB-049 source contracts; mark BB-050 READY
activationRule.staleIf: cross-domain work no longer retains the source-obligation/currentness subject required for admission revalidation
